subject: System Design
title: Network Partitions
description: A quick win: understand Network Partitions.

hook.text: A network cable is cut between two data centers. Each side thinks the other has crashed.

buildup.text: A network partition splits a cluster into groups that can't communicate with each other.

discovery.text: Each side may elect its own leader, accept conflicting writes, or refuse to serve requests.

twist.text: When the partition heals, the two sides must reconcile divergent state — often with data loss or conflicts.

climax.text: Partitions are rare but inevitable. Systems must be designed to handle them, not assume they won't happen.

punchline.text: Partitions split clusters — plan for the reunion.

quiz.question: What happens during a network partition?
options: Parts of the cluster can't communicate and may diverge
